title: Idempotent Badge Scanner
description: An automated badge-scanning system processes an array of employee access tokens of length n+1 where each token is an integer between 1 and n (inclusive). Assuming there is only one duplicate token in the sequence, find this duplicate token without modifying the original array and using constant extra space.
constraints: All the integers in nums appear only once except for precisely one integer which appears two or more times.
input_format: An array of integers nums containing n + 1 integers.
output_format: An integer representing the duplicate number.
